MessageBox.My20CheckV2:
!!! ANSWERING INCORRECTLY CAN BRICK YOUR APIM !!!

Is your SYNC 3 MY20 (manufactured in 2020 or newer)?
It is if any of these apply:
• Your car was manufactured in 2020 or newer
• Your SYNC 3 unit (APIM) was manufactured in 2020 or newer (warranty repair, replacement unit, etc.)
• Your SYNC 3 screen was manufactured in 2020 or newer (warranty repair, replacement unit, etc.)

Not sure? Run the MY20 check and Syn3 Updater will guide you through the official interrogator tool. It isn't 100% accurate. The only way to be certain is to take the APIM out and check its manufacture year.

CyanLabs are not responsible if you answer incorrectly!

App.WelcomeBody:
Syn3 Updater prepares USB drives for updating your Ford SYNC 3 system, on Windows, Linux and macOS.

**How it works**
- Enter your car's SYNC version and region in **Settings**.
- On **Home**, pick a USB drive and the version you want.
- The app downloads the files, checks them and copies them to the drive.
- Plug the drive into your car and follow the guide that opens for your install mode.
App.DisclaimerBody:
Updating your SYNC3 system carries real risk. Please read this before you continue.

- **Use at your own risk.** A wrong setting or an interrupted update can leave your SYNC unit (APIM) unusable, and repairs can be expensive.
- **Check your details.** Enter your SYNC version, region and navigation setting exactly as they appear in your car, and answer the MY20 question honestly. Wrong answers are the most common cause of a bricked unit.
- **Follow the instructions.** Use the guides at cyanlabs.net for your install mode, and never unplug the USB drive or switch off the car during an update.
- **No warranty, no liability.** Syn3 Updater and CyanLabs are provided as is. To the fullest extent the law allows, they are not responsible for any loss or damage, including to your vehicle, your data or your warranty, arising from using this app or its guides.
- **Not affiliated with Ford.** This is an unofficial tool. It is not made, approved or endorsed by Ford Motor Company, and using it may affect your vehicle's warranty.

By choosing **I understand and accept** you confirm that you have read this and accept the risks.

Diag.Intro: Checks that this computer has what Syn3 Updater needs to prepare a USB drive. Nothing is changed.
Diag.Lsblk.Fix: Install util-linux. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install util-linux. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install util-linux. Arch: sudo pacman -S util-linux.
Diag.Sfdisk.Fix: Install util-linux. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install util-linux. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install util-linux. Arch: sudo pacman -S util-linux.
Diag.Wipefs.Fix: Install util-linux. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install util-linux. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install util-linux. Arch: sudo pacman -S util-linux.
Diag.Findmnt.Fix: Install util-linux. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install util-linux. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install util-linux. Arch: sudo pacman -S util-linux.
Diag.Sync.Fix: Install coreutils with your package manager.
Diag.MkfsExfat.Fix: Install the exFAT tools. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install exfatprogs. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install exfatprogs. Arch: sudo pacman -S exfatprogs.
Diag.Pkexec.Fix: Install polkit so formatting can ask for your password. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install polkit. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install policykit-1. Arch: sudo pacman -S polkit.
Diag.Udisksctl.Fix: Install udisks2. Fedora/Nobara: sudo dnf install udisks2. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install udisks2. Arch: sudo pacman -S udisks2.
Diag.UdisksDaemon.Fix: udisks2 is installed but not answering. Try: sudo systemctl start udisks2
Diag.XdgOpen.Fix: Install xdg-utils so links and folders open from the app.
Diag.Admin.Fix: Close the app and start it again with right-click > Run as administrator. Formatting a USB drive needs it.
Diag.PowerShell.Fix: PowerShell is needed to list drives. Repair or re-enable Windows PowerShell.
Diag.Diskpart.Fix: diskpart.exe is missing from the Windows System32 folder. Repair Windows with: sfc /scannow
Diag.StorageCmdlets.Fix: Listing disks failed. Run the app as Administrator and make sure the Virtual Disk service is not disabled.
Diag.Diskutil.Fix: diskutil should be in /usr/sbin. Check that /usr/sbin is part of your PATH.
Diag.DiskutilList.Fix: diskutil could not list disks. Allow access to removable volumes in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
Diag.AppLocation.Fix: Drag Syn3 Updater into Applications and open it from there, not from the disk image or the Downloads folder.
Diag.DriveList.Fix: The drive list could not be read. Unplug and re-plug the stick; the log has the details.
Diag.DataFolder.Fix: The app cannot write to its data folder. Check its permissions and free space.
Diag.DownloadFolder.Fix: Choose another download folder in Settings.
Diag.LogFolder.Fix: Choose another log folder in Settings.
Diag.ApiToken.Fix: This build has no API key, so the server will refuse requests. Download an official release.
Diag.Api.Fix: Check your internet connection, VPN, proxy or firewall for api.cyanlabs.net.
Diag.Ford.Fix: Check your internet connection, VPN, proxy or firewall for ivsu.binaries.ford.com.
Diag.Clock.Fix: Your clock is off by several minutes. Turn on automatic date and time: a wrong clock breaks secure connections.
Diag.DownloadFolderSpace.Fix: Less than 4 GB is free. Map packages can be several GB: free some space or choose another folder in Settings.
